name: Gras
source:
"Bonjour. I'm Gras.
I was created by converting the Chassepot into a metallic cartridge breech-loader.

My brother is elegant and refined, but I'm more... practical, I suppose you could say.
My workmanship is solid and dependable. I'm not particularly flashy, but I get the job done.

Hmm? What's my relationship with Chassepot like?
Well, we get along... I think. He tends to get worked up about the most trivial things, though.

But he's still my brother. I respect him.
Oh, and one more thing. I'm not fond of being compared to him all the time.
So, Master, don't do that, alright?"
